requiredFindings.title: Present's comment includes a removed last entry
requiredFindings.failureScenario: DescriptorAcl::Present is documented as including an ACL whose last entry was removed. On this platform that filesec observation is Omitted, and the choke point must refuse it. A reader who follows the comment treats the observation as Present of an empty writer list and admits the object as no writers.

scope: 461a r1: DescriptorAcl and the custody choke point at worktree opensip-461a. The test horizon and the v80 descriptions were checked. No product cargo.
